articleTitle: Deep Learning Approach for Hand Drawn Emoji Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Object detection is a computer technology which is based on image processing and deep learning. It uses a database to recognize objects by comparing them. Emoticons are small symbols or pictures used to express opinions or emotions in instant messages. They are widely used on various social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, etc. In this paper, we focus on hand-drawn emoticons and classify them into 8 categories. Hand-drawn emoticons are created using advanced technology or drawn by hand with a pen. This paper aims to help users organize these emoticons for use in various social media with minimal confusion. We created a dataset of 4000 hand-drawn emoticon images, with 500 images per category, to train our model. Our framework uses a convolutional neural network model to recognize and classify the emoticons with a precision of 64%.

articleTitle: Smart Electronic Arm Module using Arduino Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Automation is often employed in today's society to assist people in doing their jobs and improve work efficiency. One kind of automation device that is often employed to assist humans in doing their jobs is the robot. Robots play a variety of functions in human life and are used to make a variety of human tasks easier. Robots are often used because they can make tasks simpler and more productively do them. Robots are used in many different ways to assist people in their work, including drones, welding robots, and agricultural robots. One sort of robot that we come across often is a robot arm, which performs duties comparable to those of a human arm. The robot may be controlled in its application utilizing a variety of techniques, some of which directly use a cable connection and others which utilize a wireless technique. Additionally, a controller-the robot's brain-is required to operate a robot. In order to operate the robot arm via Bluetooth, this research will create a controller based on Arduino, one of the most popular microcontroller boards for use in education, hobbies, and the workplace. The identification of the programme and data collection from various sources, such as a journal or discussion forum, are the first steps in the methodology used in this study. Next, the systems schematic design of the hardware used in this research is done, and then the Arduino programme and smartphone app are added. The select and place activity may be carried out wirelessly utilizing a Bluetooth connection by the Arduino software and the simple Android applications created using App Inventor.

articleTitle: Improving Continuous Intention in E-Learning through the use of a Combined Gamification Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The most challenging aspect of e-learning is persuading college students to continue. In e-learning, the learner's pride and intention to continue are critical components. Gamification may be the next revolutionary technology in eLearning. Gamification mixes mechanics and path diagrams to facilitate digital engagement and motivate humans to achieve their goals. Video games utilize the concept of objectives/levels, rewarding “players” for overcoming hurdles. Gamification is utilized in eLearning to encourage a game-like response and engagement, resulting in increased fact retention, motivation, and productivity. In addition, individuals who are not particularly skilled are rewarded for their efforts and encouraged to complete the courses. Implementing gamification is a complex task that involves a variety of abilities and a compelling narrative. Learners desire to be viewed as gaming enthusiasts and to be offered engaging content within strict time limitations. Content can be presented in a manner that is both visually engaging and permits immediate interaction with the instructor. During interactions, there can be quizzes, problem-solving exercises, and so on. Badges, chief boards, or vouchers are given to people who complete or achieve their goals or dreams.

articleTitle: Pandemic Outbreak Time: Evaluation of Public Tweet Opinion by Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: In this work, a Twitter data-set was utilized to do sentiment analysis of people's thoughts on the corona-virus (COVID-19) period, which is a major concern throughout the world these days, impacting a number of nations. To better understand people's feelings about the epidemic, machine learning approaches (mla) and sentiment methodology such as Bert Model (BMO), Naive_Bayes_Bernoulli (nBB), Multi Nominal Naive_Bayes (mnNB), Support_ Vector_Machine (svM), Logistic_Regression (IR), Gradient_Boosting_ Classifier (gbR), Decision Tree Classifiers (dtC), K N eighbors(knN) and Random Forest Classifier (rfC) have been presented in this work. Also, we have classified that which Classifiers provides highest accuracy. Additionally, in this paper, we also analysis from the data set, the most that has been tweeted (hashtag), positive, negative as well as neutral with data visualization in the Covid-19 epidemic time.

articleTitle: Analyzing various Machine Learning Algorithms with SMOTE and ADASYN for Image Classification having Imbalanced Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Oversampling is a strategy employed in machine learning to handle imbalanced datasets by creating copies of the minority class instances to balance the dataset, thus reducing bias and enhancing the accuracy of the model. The work presents various Machine Learning techniques to classify images from an imbalanced dataset. In this paper various oversampling techniques such as ADASYN and SMOTE are blended with the classification algorithms i.e., SVM and CNN with SVM in order to balance imbalanced datasets. The experimentation is performed on the Google Colab using different Machine Learning techniques: SVM, and (CNN and SVM). The results of the experimentation suggests that the amalgamation of SVM and CNN is better than the SVM and SMOTE is better than ADASYN on the basis of performance matrices such as recall, precision, F1 score.

articleTitle: Implementation and Analysis of Fake News using Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Fake news refers to falsified news or propaganda transmitted, broadcasted and spread by traditional as well as online platform. It includes broadcasting channels; television and print and non-traditional broadcasting media outlets and online platforms, such as social media giants like Facebook, twitter, YouTube, etc. The fake news issue continues to interfere on online world, focus has shifted to developing automated methods for detecting flawed and false internet content. However, in order to develop accurate algorithms for detecting fake news, the developers need more than just broad definitions. It establishes distinguishing characteristics which are precise enough to be used for machine learning algorithms. In this paper different classifiers used for fake news detection with the help of machine learning has been described. This may help readers to identify the real news for better perception.

articleTitle: A Compact Slotted Antenna with Two Parallel Stubs of Vertical Open-ended in Nature for Application in Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: An antenna fed by the transmission line of microstrip in nature with slotted characteristics having two parallel stubs of open-ended in nature which are emerged simultaneously from the inner edge of the middle top portion of the ground plane of rectangular slotted in nature is proposed in this paper. The antenna which is proposed is comparatively having smaller physical structure of size 24×28 mm<sup>2</sup> which produces two simultaneous resonances at 1.81 GHz and 5.91 GHz respectively which are essentially operating bands of DCS/PCS and WLAN systems. Both the resonating bands exhibiting the percentage bandwidths of 9.94 and 8.75 respectively. The peak gains at the two resonating frequencies are 3 dBi and 3.5 dBi respectively, which are sufficient for the application of DCS/PCS and WLAN. The antenna which is proposed stable patterns of radiation and gain which is appropriate in nature.

articleTitle: Stock Market Prediction Using Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: In the current world for investing money in the stock market is challenging forum and it also requires a lot of brainstorming. Since financial stock market is volatile in nature. So, it is very difficult to predict. There are some algorithms related to subject like Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Deep Learning (DL), which can give efficient accuracy compare to other techniques. In this paper, our objective to predict financial stock market price using Deep Learning techniques like Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and in particular Long-Short Term Memory model (LSTM). Using RNN and LSTM techniques for different datasets, we have to explore the accuracy by increasing number of epochs.

articleTitle: Hog Features Based Handwritten Bengali Numerals Recognition Using SVM Classifier: A Comparison with Hopfield Implementation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Handwritten digit recognition (reading by computer) is a process that gives the technological capabilities to a system to recognize handwritten numerals using Machine Learning. It is very tough to recognize handwritten characters because of the non-similarity in characters by different people. Also, there exists no standard technique available in the industry which can be applicable to provide innovative solutions to all kinds of handwritten characters. Hence, there is a requirement to understand the nature of the script. In order to complete the task, there is a need to use unique extraction methods and a classifier. This work implements a Histogram of Oriented Gradient (HOG) features with Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier and a Hopfield model to recognize handwritten Bengali numerals into the class of ten segments. SVM works in the way of mapping the input elements to a set of the high-dimensional feature vector. This works both in the case of linearly and nonlinearly and separable data. The experiments have been done using 1200 handwritten digits for 10 different classes (0 to 9). The overall accuracy (productivity) obtained from the implementation is 89.5%. The experimental outcomes from the Hopfield model give an accuracy of 95.5%. Also, it is found the Hopfield model is more capable of handling noisy inputs.

articleTitle: Drunk and Drive Detection System for Safety Driving
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Drunk and drive is leading cause of road accidents and it is the major reason behind most of the demises. The method of manual checking or scanning the vehicle drivers by using breath analyzers increasingly difficult for traffic cops. To avoid the difficulty of traffic cops, the automated drunk and drive, accident detection system with ignition lock was implemented by using Raspberry PI PICO. It aims to change with automated transparent, noninvasive alcohol safety check in vehicles. This system uses alcohol sensor MQ3, MEMS sensor, DC Motor, GSM module. GSM module locates the site of accident and correspondingly informs to the nearest person through a text message. The proposed system constantly screens the sensor output to know whether the driver was consumed alcohol or not. If driver was found to be drunk, the Raspberry PI processor instantaneously halts the vehicle ignition by stopping the DC motor otherwise the engine will run accordingly. The system also detects the vibrations of vehicle through MEMS sensor which was placed near the engine. Once the accident detects by MEMS sensor, GSM module activates to send SMS alert about the location and condition of vehicle to registered mobile number. When accident occurs, the airbag will open to save the life of the driver. In the place of airbag, LED was used. If LED glows means, airbags will open.

articleTitle: Vehicle Security and Road Safety System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Roads are the backbone of our country, they play an important role for human progress. Roads seem to be dangerous and harmful for human beings on hills, near rivers, lakes and small ridges. It's possible with the help of IoT (Internet of things) to incorporate all the things made efficiently and effectively. IoT in combination with roads make daily life smart and excellent. This paper shows IoT technology will be the beginning of smart cities and it will reduce road accidents and collisions. If all vehicles are IoT based and connected with the internet, then an efficient method to guide, it performs urgent action, when less time is available. Internet and antenna technology in combination with IoT perform fully automation in our day-to-day life. It will provide excellent service as well as accuracy and precision.

articleTitle: Block Chain Technology for Limiting the Impact of Pandemic: Open Issues and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Time stamp digital documents so that they cannot be backdated or tampered with. A two-day block chain hackathon will be organized in Bangalore on the 5th and 6th of next month. This hackathon has been named as Building Future Cities. This hackathon is being organized by crypto investing app Coin Switch. It will be organized by Karnataka government's initiative ‘Startup Karnataka’, Bangalore South MP Tejashwi Surya and Sequoia India. The organizers of the event have said that the purpose of this hackathon is to provide a platform to those working on it along with discussing the use and possibilities of block chain in India. During this hackathon, the winners will also be awarded up to three lakh rupees. Block chain has been the topic of discussion all over the world in recent times. Ever since the crypto currency era began, block chain has come into the limelight more and more, because crypto currency works on block chain technology itself. As the use of crypto currencies or NFT (Non-Fungible Tokens) is increasing all over the world, the importance of block chain technology is also increasing. Block chain technology is now starting to have its impact on the life of the common man. Many of the services we use in our daily lives may be based on block chain technology, but we are not aware of it. In this way, in today's time, it is important to know about what block chain is and how our lives are connected to it.

articleTitle: Sign Language Detection using LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Sign language is used by speech and hearing-impaired people as a method of communication. There are thousands of sign languages used all around the globe. Understanding sign language is a challenging task for a normal person. At present, speech and hearing-impaired people depend on human translators to make this task easier, but it is not always feasible to have a human translator. The objective of the present work is to design and implement an algorithm which detects real-time sign language using deep learning. The proposed system uses a Long Short-term memory model to train the dataset. The LSTM model works similarly as compared to recurrent neural networks. LSTM neural networks are used for the classification of sign language actions. A deep learning neural network is similar to the human brain in that it uses a combination of factors such as inputs, weights, and biases to perform various tasks, such as identifying and classifying objects. Deep learning algorithms work better when they are trained with a large amount of data. The performance of the proposed system has been evaluated based on accuracy, precision, and recall. The dataset consists of a Marathi sign which are daily used. The output of sign gesture is in text as well as in audio format. For audio we used google text to speech library. The proposed system could classify seven gestures with the highest training accuracy of 90-96%.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning-based Automatic Model to Predicting Performance of Students
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Machine learning offers a variety of techniques for use in diverse fields. Massive quantities of student data are produced in educational institutions, and machine-learning techniques are a precious tool for identifying patterns in individuals' behavior. Academicians can learn valuable data concerning the students' expertise and how it relates to their educational assignments by critically examining and evaluating these data. This data serves as the input for cutting-edge techniques and algorithms that can forecast students' academic achievement. This research presents a machine learning-based automatic model for predicting the performance of students. The popular ML methods are Random Forest, K-Neighbors, Extra Trees, Ada-Boost, Decision Tree, Logistic Regression, Gaussian NB, and Bernoulli NB. This research utilizes an online student performance dataset collected from Kaggle. The findings demonstrate that Random forest and decision trees outperform other techniques based on high precision as well as the capacity to interpret the guidelines and structure that were developed for predicting students' educational success.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Risk Detection using XGB Classification Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Breast cancer is cancer that forms in the breast tissue. Among all cancer deaths worldwide, many women are dying, majorly due to breast cancer. Approximately 10% of women in the world are getting affected by breast cancer at some point in their lives. Therefore, it has become a significant health problem that needs to be dealt with urgently. However, diagnosing breast cancer at early stages can increase the survival rates of patients as they can receive prompt treatment at the correct time. Additionally, it is essential to identify which type of tumor a patient has to avoid unnecessary treatment procedures. There are two types of cancers. One is benign, and the other is malignant. Both have different treatment methods, so identifying the type plays a significant role. However, the process is tiresome and may lead to disparities among pathologists. Machine learning procedures have been found to show high prediction accuracy. In order to decrease the mortality rate due to breast cancer, it is essential to predict at early stages. Wisconsin Breast cancer datasets are used for our study. Two classification models, i.e., XGB (Extreme Gradient Boosting) classifier algorithm and Gradient boosting Classifiers, are used to work on BC datasets. Datasets have been divided into training data set (80%) and test data set (20%). Initially, threefold validation methods are employed. A later prediction experiment was carried out using an XGB classifier and various performance evaluation metrics such as Confusion matrix, recall, precision, etc. By using the results obtained from performance metrics of algorithms, the best-suited model has been chosen. In our study, the XGB classifier showed the best prediction accuracy than the Light Gradient Boosting classifier (LGBM).

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Standalone PV System using System Advisor Model- A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Standalone Photovoltaic systems are alternate power generation systems which are independent of grid connectivity. They require additional PV installations which can increase cost for a remote setup. Standalone systems are designed to operate independently of the electric utility grid and normally work through battery backup so as to use electrical power during less or no irradiance typically during night when sun energy is not available. This paper studies many Performance parameters to be considered before setting up a standalone system at a selectlocation. The monthly average of atmospheric pressure, dew point temperature, wind speed and direction, average beam irradiance, average global irradiance, average diffuse irradiance are analyzed for a test location. Average DC power can be estimated based on several input parameters using system advisor model tool which provides necessary design for a standalone power plant to be setup. Also monthly irradiance prediction leads to better load management for solar power plants. This is useful for an individual to take necessary action before setting up a solar plant at any remote location.

articleTitle: An Emotion based Sentiment Analysis on Twitter Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Sentiment Analysis (SA), which employs data mining techniques to extract information from text and locate knowledge that can be used to track public opinion on certain commodities and social or political events, is one of the newest and most intriguing topics of research. One of the hottest topics in human-machine interaction right now is emotion recognition. In addition to recognizing Twitter gestures, a current research field uses textual data to determine a person's emotional condition. The primary goal of research is to identify emotions in Twitter tweets. The suggested emotion identification system outputs one of the six emotion classes when tweets are submitted (happy, sad, angry, fear, surprise, disgust). The goal is to assemble a predictive analysis of user behavior as well as the attitudes and opinions of the general public on a range of world events. The suggested hybrid emotion identification system also does well with a fresh set of features.

articleTitle: Robust Optimal PIλ Dµ Controller for Controlling Cart Inverted Pendulum System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The challenges faced by researchers in developing new control algorithms are the nonlinearity, complexity & instability of a system. Cart Inverted Pendulum is the most common example of such a system. In this system the cart will track the desired position within an acceptable amount of time, keeping the overshoot minimum and the pendulum stabilized in the upward position. LQR has been used for the stabilization of the pendulum in its desired position. Both PID & PI<sup>λ</sup> D<sup>µ</sup> controllers have been used for tracking the desired position of the cart. The controller gain values have been obtained optimally by using the TLBO algorithm. The superiority of the PI<sup>λ</sup> D<sup>µ</sup> controller over the PID controller and its robustness has been verified.

articleTitle: Priority-based Cloud-Fog Architecture for Smart Healthcare Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: With the change of lifestyle of society and increased use of IoT based equipment's in the healthcare system, various applications had knocked in modern healthcare facilities and medical data processing at the ground level. So many smart devices like watches, smart bands, mobiles and other wearable sensors are available in market to monitor the health status on regular basis. With the escalation of consumption of these smart devices, large amount of data is being generated which has led to surge in data processing load on data centers. It has posed various challenges such as data traffic, network utilization, power consumption and latency. In this paper, the priority scheduling was compared with non-priority scheduling in cloud and fog systems. The system's performance was tested in terms of energy consumption and network utilization. The results were validated with use of different data sets acquired from sensors and fog devices. iFogSim simulation tool was used for this purpose. The results also demonstrated effect of increasing the number of sensors and fog devices on network utilization and energy consumption in cloud-fog environment.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation of Urban Area Satellite Imagery Using DensePlusU-Net
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The primary and most significant region for human activity is an urban area with a high population. The most distinctive characteristics of urban environments are their dense area stock and high-intensity land use as compared to rural and other natural settings. For urban areas, imbalance is a fairly prevalent issue in the task class for remote sensing image segmentation, where large object classes predominate over small object classes. Since small object classes are typically suppressed, methods centered on improving overall accuracy are frequently insufficient. A model is designed with an up-sampling blocks for gathering the context information and a down-sampling blocks for recovering the information in order to alleviate the problem of class imbalance. In this study, we suggested an end-to-end deep convolutional network to carry out semantic segmentation of satellite imagery using aerial images of Dubai collected by MBRSC satellites dataset. DensePlusU-Net is one of thedynamicvariationof U-net network architectureand it is based on Dense Network. The experiment is based on a dataset which consists of aerial imagery of Dubai obtained by MBRSC satellites dataset and annotated with pixel-wise semantic segmentation in 6 classes; building, land, road, vegetation, water and unlabeled image data. After the experiment, it was found that, DensePlus U - Net's overall accuracy was higher than U-Net model. DensePlusU-Net achieved the overall accuracy of 86.11 % and dice coefficient score of 81 %.

articleTitle: An Efficient Machine Learning Technique for Crop Yield Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The field of agricultural research is flourishing, and the difficulties that lie ahead are being overcome with the aid of technological development. It has been determined that this is very helpful for the economic development and progress of any country. Agricultural growth to be improves by incorporating technology. In order to make strategic plans in agricultural commodities for import-export policies and to enhance farmer earnings, an early and accurate assessment of crop achievement is important in quantitative and financial evaluation at the field level. One of the tough problems in agriculture is predicting crop yields with the use of machine learning algorithms in order to forecast a larger crop output. Using this work, provide a powerful approach of machine-learning to forecast agricultural yields. By using machine learning technique can be helpful for predicting the crop yield. An experimental analysis shows that using machine learning technique crop yield productivity can be enhance.

articleTitle: Power Signal Disturbances Analysis based on Transfer Learning in Deep Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: A deep learning model based on transfer learning for power quality (PQ) disturbances detection and classification has been proposed in this article. The power disturbances are non-stationary and random so deep learning is a best choice to deal with such signals as it can estimate various random parameters of power quality disturbances such as phase, frequency and amplitude. Real time power quality disturbances are created in laboratory and accuracy of proposed model in compared with seven CNN-based DL architecture models (viz., VGG19, ResNet101, ResNet152V2, Xception, InceptionV3, MobileNet, and MobileNetv2) under serve noise conditions. Low computational overhead and high accuracy in severe noise conditions make the proposed model suitable for real time applications. The results indicated that the proposed model could realize and achieve more than 99% of accuracy. Furthermore, the proposed novel architecture could be readily used for early detection and classification of power disturbances and can be further extended to various smart cities based IoT models to realize an accurate, timely, and faster detection & classification of power disturbances in smart grid.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Modified WSN Routing Protocol with Impact of Range and Scaling Factor: M-EESAA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Data transfer across networks consumes maximum energy. The problem of improving wireless sensor network (WSN) with energy efficiency (EE) is a difficult problem. The WSN life span, which is limited by the sensing device's low battery power, can be lengthened by routing predicated on sleep awareness and wakefulness (SAA). The computation time, stability duration, as well as life of a traditional protocol must have been increased to improve EE. To address this, the article has proposed a modified M-EESAA routing protocol, which incorporates the energy scaling, absolute distance measurement, and range assessment for cluster head (CH) selection. Numerous simulations have been run to figure out the right range and energy factor for better energy balancing. The proposed method's performance is compared to three cutting-edge protocols. The parametric evaluation method is applied for identifying the optimum design parameters to improve the EE of protocol. The result is presented in terms of alive nodes stability periods, and number of packets sent to the base station. Overall, the proposed protocol version is capable of enhancing the energy use of WSN.

articleTitle: Course Recommendation System using the integration of Deep Convoluted Neural Network and Harris Hawks Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: In today's society, upskilling is important to secure a good career and advance one's career. Various courses available on online and offline platforms help in the process of upskilling. Most of the students are confused about the selection of suitable courses for their levels. Also, some student regrets their choices in future. In this scenario, the selection of an appropriate course based on the learner's past academic history is an important part. We present a course recommendation system based on deep learning in this paper. Our model (DCNN-CRS) is an integration of Deep Convoluted Neural Network (DCNN) and Harris Hawks Optimization (HHO). We have (i) used datasets from school data repositories; (ii) pre-processed removal of anomalies; (iii) extracted features with HHO; (iv) classified using DCN. Various parameters such as accuracy, specificity, sensitivity, recall, and F1-score were evaluated, and our models were compared to CNN, LSTM, RESNET, and RNN models. It was observed that our model has outperformed well compared to others. We achieved an accuracy of 94.4%.

articleTitle: Application Security using SQL Malware Detection and Prevention Scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: SQL (Structure Query Language) injection malware is a harmful instruction intended to cause an adverse effect containing database query that extracts information from the system and supplies unauthenticated access. The SQL queries are less complex and highly flexible, resembling benign queries. In earlier works, such attacks were seen to penetrate the security system of any web application. Machine learning techniques have been applied to various works to trace the SQL malicious query. Also, existing tools such as SEPTIC for the prevention of SQL malware. Earlier models are found to be less robust. This paper introduces an efficient mechanism using SVM (Support vector Machine) to conduct recognition of malware scripts. The SVM is applied to train and test various SQL strings containing benign and malware scripts. The proposed model also performs the prevention of SQL malware attacks. The SQL string prevention is done using a candid dynamic method that performs string analysis. This analysis is used to locate every context of the SQL script and perform its interpretation. In this policy, a parse tree is generated first from the input query. Further, an analysis of the nodes of the parse tree has been performed. The method can identify the benign and malware script. The proposed model is able to secure an average accuracy of 96.24% for detecting and preventing SQL malware queries. Various parameters like true positive rate, false positive rate, true negative rate, and time variation have been calculated concerning data size and accuracy.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Battery Monitoring System for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: One of the most vital and expensive components of electric vehicles is the battery. Of course, the battery is the only source of electricity for an electric vehicle. However, the vehicle's power supply eventually declines, resulting in decreased performance. For battery manufacturers, this is a major concern. In this paper, it is proposed to use IoT approaches to monitor and display the battery performance. Here, the various battery metrics, including voltage, current, and temperature, are tracked, observed, and shown. This alerts the user to prevent the battery from being overcharged or deeply discharged. With the use of various sensors, observation can be carried out. Data on voltage, current, and temperature are sent to a microcontroller unit, which subsequently transmits battery data via the cloud for display. Real-time data of voltage, current, and temperature may be displayed by the monitoring system, and the data can be seen on an Android smartphone and a computer at the same time. As a result, we might be able to improve the battery's efficiency and lifespan. The user interface and results presentation are the two main components of the proposed IoT -based battery monitoring system. According to test results, the system is able to recognize weakened battery performance and notifies the user for further action.

articleTitle: An Automated Liver Disease Detection System using Machine Learning and Smart Contract
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Liver disease is one of the leading reasons of death in both men and women worldwide. Blood pressure, Bilirubin level, Energy level, SGOT & SGPT level, blood sugar level, and Total Protein are all factors that can be observed to predict liver disease in its early stages. The existing healthcare infrastructure is being transformed by technology. With the development of the Internet of Things (IoT), doctors can now remotely monitor and analyze patients, keep their data, and process it for further examination. However, there is a requirement to introduce advanced and improved secured algorithms for quick event processing and detection. In this work, an integrated Smart Contract (SC) and Machine Learning (ML) based system is presented for detecting liver disease that, in addition to storing data in the blockchain, notifies the doctor about the patient's health status. blockchain technology provides a secure environment for storing confidential patient data. Since blockchain data is tamper-resistant, it effectively prevents unauthorized access and data falsification. Using the concept of ML, decision tree classifier variants, such as J48, Hoeffding Tree, Decision Stump, and Random Forest, are applied to the liver patient dataset for efficient classification in order to design the proposed system. The best classifier is chosen based on performance metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, F- score, etc. Finally, the selected classifier's rules are encoded in the smart contract to allow automatic and timely detection of disease. This work also discusses the proposed work's functioning and the evaluation results.

articleTitle: Short Term Load Forecasting of Urban Electric Load Profiles Using Relevance Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: This work employs supervised learning approaches, such as support vector and relevance vector machines to anticipate short-term loads for urban electric load profiles. The Holt-Winters approach, Support vector machines, and relevance vector machines are all used to determine accuracy. For the network to learn, it needs a sufficient amount of big historical data, most of which will be utilized for training and the remainder for testing. Cross-validation is carried out before learning the network with a given data set which finally leads to the increase in the accuracy of the system. Key factors like weather data, special holidays and weekend data are also included in the analysis to increase the accuracy. In short term load forecasting with SVM and RVM which are supervised learning techniques the accuracy level is quite high enough so the mean absolute percentage error resulted is very small.

articleTitle: Error Calculation of Flight Delay Prediction using Various Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Whenever an airline gets late by more than 15–20 minutes, this is termed delayed by the Federal Aviation Administration. This delay results in severe damage for airlines that operate passenger aircraft. Hence, forecasting is critical throughout the decision-making procedure for all corporate airline operators. Airlines can get delayed due to many reasons such as adverse weather, a technical fault etc. This results in the delayed arrival of the airplane at the destination airport and leaves the passengers dissatisfied. Airline and meteorological facts, a forecast model of the on-arrivals airlines, is recommended. This paper tries to employ a variety of Machine Learning and Deep Learning methods including Decision Tree, Regression analysis, Probabilistic Ridge, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting Regression, Logistic Regression, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) for error calculation. Proposed Model provides forecasting if a specified aircraft will arrive on time or not and enhance the precision of predictive models by employing hyper tuning methods.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Based WSN with High Packet Success Rate and Security
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Considering the evidence that conditions accept a considerable place in each of the structures, owing to limited assets available at each sensor center, it is a difficult problem. Vitality safety is the primary concern in many of the implementations in remote sensor hubs. This is critical as the improvement in the lifetime of the device depends primarily on restricting the usage of vitality in sensor hubs. The rationing and modification of the usage of vitality are of the most serious value in this context. In a remote sensor arrangement, the fundamental test is to schedule measurements for the least use of vitality. These classification frameworks are used to frame the classes in the structure and help efficiently use the strength that burdens out the lifespan of the network. Besides, the degree of the center was taken into account in this work considering the measurement of cluster span as an improvement to the existing methods. The crucial piece of leeway of this suggested approach on affair clustering using fuzzy logic is which can increase the lifespan of the system by reducing the problem area problem word.

articleTitle: PV Array Topology Design and Performance Evaluation under Partial Shade Situations to Reduce Mismatching Power Losses
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: In this paper, photovoltaic (PV) array system is reconfigured using the Futoshiki game theory to enhance the global maximum power point (GMPP). A comparison is carried out with the conventional PV arrangements such as series-parallel (SP) and total-cross-tied (TCT) arrangements in terms of low power loss (PL), improved fill factor (FF), and execution ratio (ER) under partial shading cases. Overall, the present study proves that the reconfigured PV array using game theory Futoshiki has higher performance compare to conventional methods. The performance indices are measured in term higher GMPP, minimized PL, improved FF for proposed methods to prove the system feasibility under test scenarios. Present study is performed through MATLAB/Simulink study.

articleTitle: Estimation of Electrical Load Reliability for Refrigeration using Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The photovoltaic power system is designed for powering an electrical load of refrigeration using energy from solar radiation. The simulation is done based on the design specification required to run the electrical load of the refrigeration system. The procedure includes the determination of the total load, identification of components required for design, solar data, and design calculation being estimated. The system is designed by considering the component's reliability such as a solar photovoltaic array, storage battery, converter, inverter, and load. For generating 62.7 Kilowatts of power for supplying an electrical load of 200-ton refrigeration, the PV panel of TP300 series of 310 peak power of Tata Solar Panel Manufacturer is used. The monthly average radiation of 5.83 KWh/m2/day of Vadodara town in Ethiopia is being used in the design. The series-connected storage batteries are used for a time when there is no radiation. The generated DC voltage is converted to AC voltage using an inverter for feeding a load of 200-tonne vapor absorption refrigeration system. The designed system is also valuable to implement in remote areas where there is no grid distribution.

articleTitle: Design Approaches of Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) Coil using ANSYS Maxwell SIMPLORER
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation approaches of wireless power transfer (WPT) systems. Transmitting and receiver coils are the heart of the WPT system. For efficient design, it should be simulated by using a suitable simulator. Many simulators such as MATLAB/SIMULINK, EM work, JMAG, PSIM, SPICE, 3DEM solver, and ANSYS MAXWELL/SIMPLORER are available for the design of the WPT coils and its controller. From most of the existing simulators, ANSYS is mostly used in many industries and by the researchers for design and performance evaluation of the coil. But, as per of author's knowledge, the detailed process of simulation and analysis of the result is not discussed in any of the literature, In this article, a detailed analysis of the design and simulation are discussed step-by-step approach. The step-by-step approaches will be very much helpful to the beginner in this field.

articleTitle: IoT based Motor Pump Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The “Internet of Things”, commonly known as “IoT”, is the most trending and most demanding technology nowadays, which interconnects physical devices like switches, sensors, and other electronic gadgets in order to collect and transfer data over a wireless based virtual environment. IoT is able to control devices remotely via smart phones and websites via algorithms or codes. Perhaps it also uses modern technology like artificial intelligence in the area of controlling tools, instruments, and others. A naval approach to controlling farm motors may be a better option for reducing human interference and increasing operating power for a set period of time. For example, to open or close the main building gate of an institute for a specific time, to operate a full-automated industrial machine for a specific time, or even to control internet and communication ports using IoT technology. This paper proposed a solution for time-bound work in various ways to be done in order to make the process fully automated with the help of the Blynk application. The motor placed on farmland can be operate not only by the Blynk application but also manually. In both cases, if manually started, it would either stop after a delay or stop by making OFF manually a part of that a Blynk application also capable of stopping the motor. This research is a prototype of all kinds of work to be done under a certain amount of time.

articleTitle: AGC of Deregulated Electric Network using Slime Mould Optimization Search Strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Deregulated electric market is hot theme in the era of modern power utilities, due to the raising utilization of the grids. To regulate the deregulated electric network, a sophisticated optimization tactic is required. In the past decade, researchers have been exercised many optimizer, and find out the feasible solution. The solutions obtained until are not a global solution because these are non-dominated each other. Therefore, finding solution for the deregulated electric network by different optimization technique is not an end global solution. In this paper, a novel augmented Slime Mould Optimizer (SMO) is proposed to obtain the best solution for deregulated electric network. And SMO dependent PI controller was used to mitigate Automatic Generation Control (AGC) difficulties in a two-area hydro - thermal - gas electric network operating in a deregulated environment is emphasized in this research. Additionally, the dynamics of power pool company (POOLCO) strategy of GENCO's with DISCOs in the similar region are permitted to contribute to the power exchange for a modest load disturbance and the comparison findings are also shown to assess the effectiveness of the suggested tactic. The results of the simulations reveal that the SMO dependent PI controller outperforms the traditional AOA dependent PI controller.

articleTitle: DCEE-ORP: Dragon Fly inspired Cluster based Energy Efficient Opportunistic Routing Protocol for WSNs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: WSNs provide fine-grained measurements of the real world. A WSN comprises of several battery-operated sensor nodes with computing, communication, and processing capabilities. Data is collected by sensors, such as those that measure temperature, air pollution, pressure, etc. To construct an entire sensor node, some supporting components, such as power supply, are required. They're widely dispersed; each can sense the physical surroundings, collect aggregated data, and transmit it to the base station or sensor nodes. The researched proposal on Dragon Fly inspired Cluster based Energy Efficient Opportunistic Routing Protocol for WSNs (DCEE-ORP) is based on the Dragonfly algorithm. It is used to filter signals or data and optimize the route. The performance of DCEE-ORP is compared to that of rival routing protocols on crucial criteria such as average energy usage and packet delivery ratio. The results demonstrate that the DCEE-ORP performs much better than its competitors in terms of energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Intelligent Framework for Task Placement and Resource Allocation for IoT in the Fog-Cloud Scenario
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: In order to identify the latency-critical applications, this research develops an intelligent task placement and resource allocation framework (ITPRAF) that makes use of supervised feed forward neural networks. This algorithm runs through two stages. To decide whether to schedule a task for execution in the fog or send it to the cloud in the first part, this machine learning-based system uses the task's attributes as input. To ensure the best resource usage, jobs that are put to fog are reshuffled keeping into account the priority at the fog queue in the second phase. Four mechanisms for resource allocation in fog are presented in this research. Through the simulation results from various iterations, the reaction time, resource consumption, and delay satisfaction rate of each scenario were compared.

articleTitle: Real-Time Classification of Cardiac Events in Arrhythmia Disease
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Millions of people lose their lives in a year due to the devastating heart condition known as Sudden Cardiac Arrest (SCA) due to Arrhythmia. Therefore, SCA could be predicted or diagnosed early, potentially preventing more deaths. In this study, we aim to devise a space and computation-time-efficient approach for the classification of SCA in near real-time. The MIT-BIH Arrhythmia dataset was used to train the classifiers such as CNN, hybrid of CNN and Long Short Term Memory (LSTM). The quantization technique was employed in the CNN models to achieve compression. To further improve compression, we proposed a method by integrating variable width quantization with retraining.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Spectrum Sensing over Cognitive Radio Network with Joint Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: It has been suggested that cognitive radio, or CR for short, be used as a method to increase the efficiency of spectrum utilization. This is accomplished by providing unlicensed users with opportunistic access to vacant or underutilized spectrum. Coordinated multipoint joint transmission (JT), also known as joint transmission between several sites, is an additional potential technique for improving the performance of cognitive radio networks. We present a coordinated multipoint JT technique as a part of a CR system in this study. An analytical model for the received signal-to-noise ratio at a CR is developed in order to determine the energy detection threshold and the smallest number of samples required for energy detection-based spectrum sensing in a CR network (CRN) with the CoMP JT technique. This is done in order to determine the energy detection threshold. The received signal-to-noise ratio at a CR can be calculated with the help of this model. The reliability of energy detection-based spectrum sensing was assessed using simulation, and it was determined to be effective. The analytical model is created using the MATLAB software with using communication tool box. With the aim of maximising the users' least throughput, setting the channel allocation and user scheduling with a coordinated multipoint JT approach is presented as an optimization problem.

articleTitle: Implementation of Siamese Network for Similarity Computation and Prediction of Handwritten Digits
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Consistently machines are getting increasingly modern, from evaluation of addition to handwritten text recognition. Machines have made our lives more precise, sensible, and quick. Goal of this paper is to get familiar with a similarity measure to distinguish the distance of data points in vector space and afterward recognize the labels of unlabeled data through label propagation. Thus, proposed technique has matched another digit image and tracking down similarities of same by utilizing a Siamese network. Likeness between the new images from the current trained framework is being determined and has been shown in output structure. Paper has proposed a prediction rule to distinguish the labels of unlabeled datasets with the assistance of few labeled data points and tracking down likenesses. The strategy utilizes pre training of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for vector creation on the MNIST digits dataset. This MNIST dataset has 70000 images of manually written digits accessible for experimental and trial investigation. Main aim of this paper is to find the distance of the vector determined for labeling and matching closeness in the image and making a pair of same images.

articleTitle: Task Offloading Strategy using Double Q-Learning based Optimization in MEC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Deep learning assisted mobile edge computing (MEC) has recently gained a lot of attention because of its superior ability to decrease the amount of energy and latency of MEC offloading. Energy usage during MEC offloading should be kept to a minimum, a multi-objective optimization problem is formulated, and a low-complexity allocating resources approach is implied. The paper proposes a deep double q-learning (DDQN) based optimization for MEC energy consumption reduction. The result analysis shows that energy consumption with respect to variable tasks and variable users. According to result analysis, it was observed that with increasing number of task and number of users, the energy consumption increases. With DDQN optimization energy consumption is reduced as compared to without DDQN optimization.

articleTitle: Analysis of Personality Traits of Handwriting with Comparison of Different Techniques of Personality Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Combination of characteristics and qualities of an individual is called personality. Personality of a person can be judged by various parameters; it varies according to the environment of the person; inter relationships with the surroundings, past experiences of life, nature, and skills. Handwriting is a unique feature of each person, which helps to detect the person's behavior, and certain psychological aspects. Graphoanalysis is a process to analyze personality based on handwriting. In this paper we analyze different research studies of personality identification based on handwriting. There are many features of handwriting like baseline, strokes which demonstrate psychological characteristics of the writer. In this research we analyze different states of art techniques of personality detection. This study gives a detailed review of many parameters of Handwriting which are examined for personality prediction.

articleTitle: Design of Highly Dense Wide Area Sensor Network Using Enhanced LEACH Routing Protocols: E-LEACH
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The excessive usage of sensors is predicted to considerably enhance the network's density and area in the near future. Consequently, it is essential to test the effectiveness of the wireless sensor network (WSN) for such DWANs. An Enhanced LEACH protocol-based routing approach to extend a network's lifespan is the primary focus of this study. When evaluating DWAN, the distribution of the extremely dense nodes is taken into consideration. The initial network's energy should be increased in proportion to its area and density. The network's lifespan performance is evaluated using the E-LEACH method, and the initialization design parameters, such as node density, energy, and cluster formation starting probability, are altered. For experimentation node density and area is considered from 300 to 1000 and the number of packets sent and the number of cluster heads (CH) are expected to enhance.

articleTitle: Real-Time Based ANFIS Control of Two Wheel Robotic (TWR) System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: This article presents design and control of a highly nonlinear and multivariable two-wheeled robotic (TWR) system. A model of TWR system has been designed and controlled using an Arduino UNO microcontroller equipped with a MPU-6050 sensor. The real-time data for chassis angle and chassis angular velocity was obtained through Arduino Uno controller and was used for training of an Adaptive neuro fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) controller. ANFIS controller has been designed using only seven gbell shape membership function which solved the problem of fuzzy rule explosion by reducing the number of fuzzy rules from 256 to 49 compared to ANFIS controller proposed in one of the previous studies of author. Moreover, through proposed technique it was successfully possible to stabilize the chassis angle and chassis angular velocity within 2.0 sec and 2.5 sec respectively within acceptable overshoot and steady state error limits.

articleTitle: Designing of High Voltage Double - Y Type Harmonic Filter Bank for Reactive Power Compensation and Harmonic Mitigation of 350 Ton / 50 MVA Ladle Furnace at Steel Melt Shop - A Study of Real Case
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The ladle furnace plays a very important role in the manufacturing of steel. A ladle furnace is used in the refining of liquid steel to obtain superior-grade steel. A ladle furnace is a disturbing load that affects the system's power quality and power factor. The harmonics created and the ladle furnace's low power factor are two issues that need to be addressed. The harmonic filter bank provided the best solution to take care of the harmonics and lagging power factor due to the ladle furnace. This paper includes a detailed case study of designing a harmonic filter bank for the improvement of power factor and harmonic mitigation of a real 350 ton/50 MVA ladle furnace in a steel plant.

articleTitle: Vertical-Architecture based Nanowire TFET using Gate Engineering Technique- Design and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: This paper is focusing on the designing and boosting of performance by using gate engineering technique. In this paper a Gate Stacked (GS)- Double Metal Gate (DMG)- Vertical Nanowire Tunnel FET (VNWTFET) i.e. GS-DMG-VNWTFET is proposed, also the analog parameters and structural parameters are analyzed. By using both the gate engineering technique a better electrostatic controllability over channel could be archived. Before proposing GS-DMG-VNWTFET; GS-VNWTFET and DMG-VNWTFET were also analyzed. This paper is tracking all the devices like conventional- VNWTFET, GS-VNWTFET, DMG-VNWTFET and GS-DMG-VNWTFET. With the proven advantage of vertical nanowire structures, a better controllability over gate exists. In addition to this performances like drain-to-source current (I<inf>DS</inf>), energy band diagram, trans conductancetgs.), gate-to-source capacitance (C<inf>GS</inf>. gate-to-drain capacitance (C<inf>GD</inf>), total-gate-capacitance (C<inf>GG</inf>), cut-off frequency (f<inf>T</inf>), potential, electric field, electron & hole concentration, electron & hole quasi fermi level (QFL) and electron band-to-band-tunneling (BTBT) rate; it is observed that our device is providing the best results as compared to other devices. Addition of these gate techniques, an improved performance is recorded for the proposed GAA device. The parameters such as on current I<inf>ON</inf>, off current (I<inf>OFF</inf>), Sub threshold Slope (SS) and Drain Induced Barrier Lowering (DIBL) of all four devices conventional-VNWTFET, GS-VNWTFET, DMG-VNWTFET and GS-DMG-VNWTFET are also compared; here also GS-DMG-VNWTFET is performing the best. GS-DMG-VNWTFET has performance parameters such as 1.06×10<sup>−6</sup> A/µmon current, 2.79×10<sup>−22</sup> A/µm off-current, 3.801×10<sup>+14</sup> on-to off current ratio, SSof10.9mV/Decade and minimum value of DIBL as 457mV/V.

articleTitle: Secure Cluster based Routing Protocol for WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), data communication is performed using different routing protocols. One of the mostly used routing protocol is cluster-based routing protocol. The foundation of cluster-based routing protocol is the formation of clusters and selection of Cluster Head (CH) for energy-efficient transmission. CH are solely responsible for data packets transmission among nodes. But, such protocols are susceptible to network attacks. In this paper, a novel secure cluster-based routing protocol is designed for safe data transmission. Based on the findings, the designed solution offers excellent capabilities in terms of packet delivery ratio (PDR), energy usage, throughput, and End-to-End delay.

articleTitle: Real-time Speech Emotion Detection using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The study of emotions has become a significant field of study that offers potential insights for a range of applications. Man-machine interfaces must be able to detect the user's emotional state and respond appropriately. Real-time applications of automatic emotion recognition include detecting the emotions of mobile phone users, call center operations, car drivers, pilots, etc. Emotions like happiness, joy, anger, sadness, neutral, boredom, disgust, fear and surprise can be predicted with the use of conventional algorithms such as the LSTM, Bayesian network using the Maximum Likelihood Estimation Principle and Support Vector Machine is proposed. MFCC (Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients), Hamming/Hanning windows, Mel-Filter bank model were used in the proposed novel LSTM model. Implementation of novel LSTM model was performed and yielded an accuracy of 98(%). A dynamic webpage that can capture an individual's voice and predict their emotional state was implemented using the same.

articleTitle: Studying the Frequency Behavior of the Interdigital Capacitive Sensor During Water Level Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Inter digital capacitive (IDC) sensor is useful in numerous applications. In this work, a prototype of a comb IDC sensor is developed using the PCB fabrication technique to study the effect of frequency during water head transition. The mathematical and graphical analysis of the work is based on the collected real-time data. A statistical tool Pearson's are justifying the linearity of the sensor. The statistical result of Pearson's r values (> 0.9924) illustrates a strong positive correlation between the two variables, capacitance, and water level. It is found that the IDC sensor has good linearity with the water level transition for the 0.5 kHz to 40 kHz frequency range.

articleTitle: Exploring Mind Powers of Rishis Inspired Optimization Algorithm for Genuine Power Loss Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: In this paper Exploring mind powers of Rishi inspired optimization (EMPRO) algorithm is applied for solving the Genuine Power Loss Reduction problem. In projected EMPRO algorithm how the Rishi or Yogi mind is reconnoitering and uniting in a particular region is emulated to model the EMPRO algorithm. Numerous junctures Yogi will purse the mediation by setting a particular facet. In this work two Yogis are considered in the scientific design and Procedure produces new investigational coordinates from end to end perplex; consequently, this perplex scheme is the prime. Succeeding investigational coordinates are produced in arbitrary manner Together the Migration coordinates and functional values create the Counterbalance and it gets altered rendering to specific Yogi. This computation is idiosyncratic by means of choosing migration coordinates and through that Counterbalance will be calculated. Chaotic features are integrated into the algorithm to enhance the quality of the solution.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Dual-Metal (DM) Dielectric-Pocket (DP) Nanotube MOSFETs at Extreme Temperature Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The present article is about boosting the performance of Nanotube (NT) MOSFETs by using three performance booster techniques. A dielectric pocket (DP) equipped channel degrades the off-state current (Ioff) while a high-k dielectric gate enhances the on-state current (Ion) of NT MOSFETs. In addition, the dual-metal (DM) gate approach has been used to improve immunity towards short-channel effects (SHEs). It has been perceived that the proposed structure, enhances the Ion by 64.8%, and degrades the Ioff by 78% as compared with NT MOSFET. These performance booster techniques also fight against performance degradation caused by temperature variation. The paper also deals with the comparative analog/RF performance analysis of DM-DP-NT, and NT MOSFETs for temperature variations from 250K (-23 °C) to 600K (327 °C) using the TCAD device simulator.

articleTitle: Designing of a Hybrid DWT-SVD Watermarking Technique of Color Images with Digital Signature
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: An important technological innovation in recent years for recognizing details of copyright holders and enabling multimedia security is digital image watermarking. Watermarking is the most common way of hiding digital information in a carrier color image having secret information. As a result, the host data are secured by introducing watermark data, which an eavesdropper cannot remove or modify. This technique creates highly protected pictures and ensures content authenticity, integrity authentication, including tamper resistance. Various approaches have been put out in recent years, either focused on the spatial, transform, or both domains. A secure multi-level based watermarking is suggested in this paper. The YCbCR format serves as the basis for the color reproduction. The Discrete wavelet transform (DWT)-Singular value decomposition (SVD) domain incorporates a digital signature as a modification. The adaptive DWT level and scaled SVD values are used to implement the watermarking. The performance evaluation has the best setting for the scaling factor alpha in this paper. The performance of the proposed watermarking is tested under Gaussian noise attack.

articleTitle: Optimization of Diabetes Risk Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Diabetes mellitus is observed as a disease in which social, human and financial expenses of a nation is highly affected. Simultaneously, it is necessary to reduce the rate of commonness along with this the confusions needed to be resolved regarding diabetes. In industries including education, healthcare, and agriculture, Artificial intelligence has made tremendous progress in the ability to diagnose and cure diseases like cancer and diabetes faster than traditional approaches. In order to predict diabetes diagnosis based on parameters specified in patients from all diabetes data in the PIMA Indian database, the first phase of this study will present a comparative neural network analysis and will deploy a neural network classifier improved by Firefly algorithm. The positive diabetes patients are defined by class ‘0’ value and negative diabetes patients are defined by class ‘1’. The total Diagnosis diabetes dataset is 768. All dataset applied to the gradient boosting machine learning technique and get the 500 dataset is not diabetes and 268 dataset is diabetes. In proposed algorithm we used an ensemble of gradient boosting to achieve an accuracy of 81.95%. The Majority vote-based model as demonstrated which comprises of decision tree (DT), random forest (RF), artificial neural network (ANN), support vector machine (SVM), K-nearest neighbor (KNN), logical regression (LR), Ada boost classification (ABC) and gradient boosting classification (GBC) gives the accuracy of 81 %, 88%, 35%, 83%, 84%, 81 %, 87% and 88%. Similarly gives the precision, recall and Fi-score show result in table.

articleTitle: Image Caption Generation using Deep Residual Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The process of creating a written description of an image that describes the action depicted in it is known as image captioning. It is one of the most challenging study areas, and the only method that can help is the machine learning one. Image captioning is a tool where intellectual approach is required for better performance. The suggested work uses CNN, RNN, and Deep Residual Network to propose an image captioning system. RNN serves as the decoder while CNN serves as the encoder. For the MSCOCO benchmark, the system can accurately infer the state of affairs. Deep Residual Network (Deep ResNet), which efficiently utilises the layers and cuts down on computation time, was used to train the model. Deep ResNet, also known as skip connection, bypasses the convolutional layers that provided a solution to the gradient explosion problem. Comparing the Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) score to the previously used model, the system perceived a higher score. By lowering the image's size and improving its visibility return good results.

articleTitle: An Optimal Cluster Fusion and Morphological Segmentation Technique for IRIS Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The biometric identification and also eyeball analysis may require designing an efficient Iris Recognition (IR) technique. Existing IR methods based on the FCM and clustering needs an improvement in segmented area determination. This paper has proposed wavelet based cluster Fusion approach to improve the performance of K-mean clustering. This may control issues of multi cluster representation of objects. The thresholding based segmentation is applied on fused cluster image. In order to eliminate the unwanted boundaries, the morphological processing is performed. Finally, circle fitting is applied to track an Iris region. Performance of existing and proposed Iris segmentation is compared. It is observed that the proposed Iris detection is less complex and efficiently works for all kind of images.

articleTitle: Multimedia Security in Audio Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The security of Digital media has been varying continuously due to advanced malware attacks. Multimedia security has become one of the major concerns. Earlier works primarily relied on encryption techniques to provide multimedia security, but those works have become obsolete and may be challenged by imposters as technology grows. The proposed work applied watermarking technique in the digital audio signal in which unique data is inserted in one-dimensional data so that it must not affect the significant information of the audio signal. The hybrid-decomposition scheme has been introduced over the audio data to extract features in terms of energy bands. The hiding of the watermark (image data) occurs in a low significant energy band that is stable and contains less information. The watermark extraction method is also introduced in which the hidden watermark data has been extracted back to its original form without leaving any distortion in audio data. The hybrid audio decomposition technique is a scheme in which dual decomposition of host audio signal has been applied containing fast Fourier transform (FFT) and Cordic QR scheme. The disintegration of the audio file will finally result in Q and R matrices under the Cordic QR scheme. Pseudo-random sequence method has been applied to find the correct location from the energy band of the R matrix to embed the watermark data. Before embedding, the watermark first undergoes dual encryption using cyclic coding and Arnold's cat map scheme. The reverse procedure has been applied for the watermark extraction and decryption process. The average PSNR value is 37.8 dB for watermarked audio.

articleTitle: Neuro-fuzzy Approach based Prediction of Thermodynamic Properties of Steam
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: This article presents a machine learning based neuro-fuzzy approach for predicting different thermodynamic properties of steam namely enthalpy of liquid and enthalpy of vapour. The experimental data from literature has been collected and used for training of a novel neuro-fuzzy controller designed using different number of gbell shape membership functions. The enthalpy has been considered as a function of saturation temperature, pressure, specific volume of liquid and specific volume of vapour. The performance of proposed controller has been monitored and compared in terms of Root mean square error (RMSE), Mean absolute error (MAE) and Mean absolute percentage error (MAPE). Results indicate best prediction performance of neuro-fuzzy controller designed using five gbell shape memberships.

articleTitle: Analysis of Plant Leaf Disease Based on Sensor and Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: Plant disease detection is crucial in the field of agriculture as it impacts yield and overall production. Due to the above mentioned issue going to impact the food supply chain. Agriculture is a primary source for food generation thus there is a need to provide the cost effective solution for leaf disease detection. There are various techniques to detect a leaf disease in which image or numerical based data extraction is widely used due to its accuracy. Thus low cost flexible leaf sensor integrated with the above method is suitable to resolve the afar mentioned Challenge. This paper explores the advantages of low cost sensor over the reported work and hybrid machine-learning (H.M.L) algorithm is proposed for disease detection.

articleTitle: A Cloud based Mobile Application to Hire Unskilled Workers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: In this modern era, the Majority of individuals are preferring mobile applications for the completion of their work. Generally, there are some applications that can hire skilled workers. People living in cities cannot directly contact the workers. The proposed system will help people to hire workers on a daily/contract basis. It gives everyday work to the workers who will be idle. This system will help both Employers and workers as well. This proposed system offers services specifically for laborers in the construction industry. Workers and Employers have to register and login into the system. The worker profile page contains the details such as location, types of work, activity status, and demand wages. Whereas, Employer profile page contains the details such as work location and personal information. Payment can be done offline. Work providers can rate the worker's performance.

articleTitle: Analytics on Risk Factors Correlated to Non-Communicable Diseases using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: The prevalence of non-communicable diseases (NCDs) is a significant global issue. This study tries to estimate the population's shared risk factors for NCDs. The general public who are unaware of the risk factors for NCDs, including high blood pressure, strenuous activity, smoking habits, and many more, can benefit from this. Data from rural areas, where people are less knowledgeable about such disorders, have been used. Spark will be used to perform preprocessing on this unstructured input to create structured data. The structured data that will be kept in the database will be analyzed using the machine learning algorithm. Dashboards will be used to display the analytical results. If some metrics exceed a certain limit based on analytics, the likelihood of contracting the disease will be forecasted. According to analytics, if any metrics exceed the then particular limit then risk for the disease can be anticipated.

articleTitle: Role of Blockchain and Smart Contracts in Healthcare -Challenges and Benefits
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Current Development in Engineering and Technology (CCET)
abstract: It is essential for healthcare 4.0, which includes patients and their care professionals, to have a dependable operating system to operate in a way that is free from the potential for danger. Items that are consistent with the current trajectory of economic progress when it comes to keeping a distributed ledger with several points of access honest, blockchain technology might be of assistance. This work investigates how technology may be used to raise the dependability of various types of systems. Further, a brief survey and comparative analysis of blockchain and smart contract-based development, operation, and maintenance of healthcare information systems are prepared in this work.

articleTitle: Design of a Modified Current Starved Inverter Based Ring Oscillator for Switched Capacitor Circuit
